product_rule: General ERP plus optional company-enabled permission-scoped industry packs

work_packages.name: Whole application experience and regression
work_packages.evidence_basis: Shared native theme, navigation, forms, tables, meaningful state motion and reduced motion

work_packages.name: Business industry setup and access control
work_packages.evidence_basis: Company industry setup, scoped capabilities, readiness, active/closing/inactive lifecycle, original User/Role/User Permission

work_packages.name: Knitting masters jobs programmes and rates
work_packages.evidence_basis: Jobs and programmes, estimates over original Quotation, fixed commercial revisions, industry masters and original ERP masters

work_packages.name: Yarn ownership custody processing and general stock
work_packages.evidence_basis: Source-linked yarn receipt/order/bill, kg and physical-unit custody, allocation, godown/job transfer, processing and count adjustment

work_packages.name: Machine planning capacity and shortages
work_packages.evidence_basis: Compatible machine allocation, explicit operating shifts, holiday/stoppage checks and current planning/shortage/change reports

work_packages.name: Roll production operator shifts and corrections
work_packages.evidence_basis: Single/bulk production, immutable source roll identities, actor/shift attribution, split and guarded reversals

work_packages.name: Quality inspections touch station and release
work_packages.evidence_basis: QC decisions and reinspection history, active defects, released-roll delivery guard

work_packages.name: Delivery returns transfers invoicing and closure
work_packages.evidence_basis: Released-roll delivery/challan, exact source invoice/credit/physical return, reconciliation and reasoned completion/reopening, original accounting

work_packages.name: Subcontract custody receipts bills and closure
work_packages.evidence_basis: Original subcontract PO/bill, separate custody, fabric receipt, surplus return, commitment limits and audited short closure

work_packages.name: Stoppage needle sinker consumables and margin
work_packages.evidence_basis: Component boundary/run/replacement and attributed breakage, stoppage, original consumable stock and margin-before-overhead report

work_packages.name: Operational registers reports and reconciliation
work_packages.evidence_basis: Shared job/yarn/fabric/roll/production/QC/planning/subcontract/activity/billing reports with supported filters/grouping and original ERP reports

work_packages.name: Prints numbering export and provider integrations
work_packages.evidence_basis: Roll-ID QR labels, customer custody challan and original ERP PDF, CSV and independent GST/Tally review formats; live providers unconfigured

work_packages.name: Migration recovery packaging and target devices
work_packages.evidence_basis: Guarded synthetic import/replay and aggregate recovery tests, local packaging, supported local builds; full-site/customer/device gates remain
